# Compatibility Fixtures
`checkpoint-v2.json` contains synthetic schema-2/chunking-3 journals and exact TXT/SRT/VTT/JSON outputs produced by the pre-refactoring implementation (base `81b6703`, behavior retained by `0188baf`). The input is the literal string `deterministic input`; no recording, model or real transcript is included.

Paths are normalized to `/fixture`. Schema 2 is intentionally rejected without modifying its records: schema 3 adds container-time PCM and immutable publication metadata. Keep the old fixture unchanged to test this boundary.

`checkpoint-v3.json` is a frozen hand-authored schema-3/timeline-1/chunking-3 contract, reusing the original synthetic chunk bytes and hash. It is now rejected without modifying its records: codec timing, gap policy and exact-silence skipping require explicit algorithm version changes even though the checkpoint schema remains 3.

`checkpoint-v3-timeline-v2.json` freezes the schema-3/timeline-2/chunking-4 contract before negative clock drift became recoverable in all containers. It is rejected without modifying its records.

`checkpoint-v3-timeline-v3.json` independently specifies the current schema-3/timeline-3/chunking-4 fingerprint, original run metadata and caption/text outputs, reusing the same synthetic segments. Tests relocate source/output paths, change the current model spelling and CPU count, resume the journal and verify that publication retains the original metadata. Fixtures contain no media or weights; expected results must not be regenerated by the implementation under test.
